description: A developer workbench for DSH: a GPU-accelerated terminal (restty renderer, Rust PTY) and a sandboxed browser, hosted in a self-contained right sidebar (panel + tab bar copied from dsh-better-sidebar's layout/wrapper, with powerdesk's own terminal + browser as the tabs). Exposes a restty-native wire-protocol WebSocket at /powerdesk/ws/terminal and a browser embeddability probe at /powerdesk/api/browser.probe.
